method: Actually displayed all three saved contact panels through view_image, examining paired frames0,40,80 at0,2.5,5seconds. Model/shape/seed/commit/time labels are legible; paired framing, colors, vessel geometry and reflections match.

observations.short: Both columns show two red teapots by a sunlit window; the same camera/framing progression and highlights occur in all three sampled times. The duplicate teapot is a shared generation artifact.
observations.long: Both columns show a red teapot with two spout-like protrusions, blue steaming cup, pale cloth and window. The duplicated spout is shared, with no visible main/PR difference at the sampled times.
observations.chinese: Both columns show the same malformed stacked lid/handle assembly on a red vessel and a blue cup with a spout-like protrusion. Shared baseline artifacts remain visible; the separate cross-Omni PSNR failure is retained and excluded from primary performance admission.

limits: Representative frames only; full motion was not watched. Whole-video MP4 bytes and all81decoded-frameRGBhashes were independently checked in the raw audit. Exactness versus main does not establish semantic prompt quality or fix cross-framework failures.
